# AVE EcoTech Pvt Ltd

> Green construction materials, made in India. AVE EcoTech turns plastic and industrial waste into EcoTiles: 100% recycled, zero-cement paver tiles for builders, green architects and public bodies. Based in Pune, Maharashtra.

Tagline: Turning Waste into Sustainable Infrastructure.

## Product: EcoTiles
- Paver tile, 1 sq.ft per tile, 25 mm thick, 2.5 kg per tile (about 40% lighter than a cement paver)
- 100% recycled content, zero cement, 0% wastage on site (laid without cutting)
- Water absorption under 1%; acid and algae resistant; anti-skid; colour-fast in UV; no spalling
- Designed to handle 30+ tonnes on a properly prepared base
- Colours: green, charcoal, terracotta, slate blue, sand; custom colours on bulk orders
- Contributes towards green building credits under IGBC, LEED, GRIHA and GEM (contribution, not certification)

## Where it is used
Footpaths and streetscapes, parking and driveways, stilt parking, terraces and podiums, gardens and resorts, pool decks, industrial and chemical lab floors, home verandahs.

## Who it is for
- Builders and developers: fewer man-days, zero cutting waste, less dead load on podiums, priced against conventional pavers
- Green architects: recycled, cement-free, test reports supplied for specification
- Government and public bodies: aligned with Smart City and Net Zero goals; turns local waste into public infrastructure

## Proof
Installed at Midori Towers, Mamurdi, Pune (poolside) for P Square Realty, and at private homes. Trusted by Sustain & Save and Saikrushna Developers.
